scientific_intent.scientific_operator: Kmer inventory filtering, base-composition filtering and exact integer LCS acceptance in greedy representative read clustering.
scientific_intent.community_use: Redundant sequencing-read removal as declared by the source read FASTA pipeline. This is a heuristic forward-sequence similarity grouping component, not an exhaustive all-pairs biological homology or assembly-quality study.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact valid kmer inventories/counts, strict source cutoff decisions, full ungapped integer LCS scores/decisions against independent DP, full final clusters and FASTA. Full actual GPU state/input/guards and tagged deterministic replay states retained.
limitations: Conditional host valid-kmer compaction correction; all original GPU bodies unchanged, excluded untouched-native aggregate.
Final clusters/FASTA already agree original on measured fixtures: observed original defect is intermediate inventory, not demonstrated wrong biological groups.
Lengths128..192, n17/17/33/129, k4..7, positive valid-word counts, forward-only; no empty/allgap/overlength/reverse-complement or original missing FASTA dataset certification.
Source strict heuristic filters retained; no exhaustive recall or real-data biological-quality guarantee.
U/u conversion source-reviewed but not exercised.
Preallocated pipeline ROI, allocation-inclusive full source CLI unmeasured.

shared_observed_usage_windows.scope: Consumed inference tokens during declared phase, including repeated/cached context and any coordination. Marker-turn alignment is approximate; not exclusive source translation or monetary billing. Cached input and reasoning are subsets, not extra totals. No historical recovery. Parent/shared workflow spans overlap subphases and must not be added to them.

observed_model_metadata.lookup_method: Latest complete same-stream turn_context not later than the usage event, backward bounded-memory scan.
observed_model_metadata.scope: Observed configured identifier only; exact serving snapshot/seed/temperature unknown. No cross-stream inference and no historical token recovery.

shared_observed_usage_windows.counter_span_interpretation: Observed counter difference; alignment and interleaving prevent exclusive billed-cost claims. Zero/no-new-event spans cannot imply zero translation effort.
